title: MOSS: A Production Framework for Monitoring and Diagnosing Semantic Failures in Search and Recommendation Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.26902v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Detecting semantic failures in production recommendation and search systems is hard: behavioral metrics lag by days, manual review does not scale, and most LLM evaluation frameworks are designed for offline, fixed datasets rather than continuous operational monitoring. We present Model Sanity Service (MOSS), a production framework that addresses this operational gap by embedding LLM-based relevance scoring into a recurring monitoring loop with targeted sampling, strategy-aware prompting, structured alerting, and diagnostic follow-up prompting that categorizes failures into actionable root causes.   MOSS has been running in production at a large U.S. retailer for over six months across recommendation, search, and offer surfaces, and has surfaced two confirmed serving defects. translated_title: MOSS：用于监控和诊断搜索与推荐系统中语义故障的生产级框架
translated_abstract: 在生产环境的推荐和搜索系统中检测语义故障十分困难：行为指标滞后数天，人工审核无法规模化，而且大多数LLM评估框架是为离线固定数据集设计的，而非用于持续的运行监控。我们提出了Model Sanity Service（MOSS），这是一个填补该运维空白的生产级框架，它将基于LLM的相关性评分嵌入到周期性监控循环中，结合针对性采样、策略感知提示、结构化告警，以及能将故障归类为可操作根因的诊断性后续提示。MOSS已在一家美国大型零售商的生产环境中运行超过六个月，覆盖推荐、搜索和优惠等多个业务面，并已发现了两个得到确认的服务缺陷。针对其中一个回填混合缺陷，MOSS离线量化了所提出修复方案的影响，显示告警率相对降低了76.4%。（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: MOSS是一个将LLM相关性评分嵌入持续监控循环的生产级框架，通过针对性采样和诊断性提示自动检测并归类推荐与搜索系统中的语义故障，已在大型零售商运行六个月并成功发现两个线上服务缺陷，还能离线量化修复效果（告警率相对降低76.4%）。
en_tdlr: MOSS is a production framework that embeds LLM-based relevance scoring into a recurring monitoring loop with targeted sampling, strategy-aware prompting, and diagnostic follow-up prompting to detect and categorize semantic failures in search and recommendation systems, having run for over six months at a large U.S. retailer and surfaced two confirmed serving defects.
